candidates.change_summary: Remove the disjunct checking for the IERC1155 interfaceId, so IERC1155's interface id is no longer supported.
Remove the disjunct checking for the IERC1155MetadataURI interfaceId, so that interface id is no longer supported.
Remove the super.supportsInterface(interfaceId) disjunct, so the IERC165 interface id is no longer supported.
Remove the zero-address check so calls with the zero address return a balance (0) instead of reverting, changing behavior for completing calls.
Swap the mapping index order so the balance is looked up as _balances[account][id], returning a different value for most inputs.
Return the account address cast to uint256 instead of the stored balance, changing the return value for all holders.
Return the id instead of the stored balance, changing the return value for calls with nonzero ids.
Remove the zero-address check so balanceOf(address(0), id) returns 0 instead of reverting.
Swap the mapping keys so the balance is read as _balances[account][id] instead of _balances[id][account].
Return the balance of the id shifted by one slot so balanceOf returns _balances[id + 1][account].
Loop stops one element early, leaving the last batch balance as zero.
Swap the arguments to balanceOf, looking up the account for the id and the id for the account.
Delete the loop so the returned array is all zeros instead of actual balances.
Increment the loop counter by 2, leaving every other entry as zero.
Return a fresh zeroed array instead of the computed batchBalances.
